content:
Returns the details of the specified recast or accept rule.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role or one of the following custom role privileges:
TIO_BACKEND.RECAST_RULE.READ  for Vulnerability Management or WAS.RECAST_RULE.READ
for Web App Scanning. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
The UUID of the recast rule to return details for.
